unit.title: Inequalities, Absolute Value, and Formulas
unit.act: Act III - Describing regions and constraints
unit.role: Extend algebra from exact equality to ranges, distance conditions, and reusable formulas.
unit.governingQuestion: How do we describe all values satisfying a condition?
unit.storyArc: Equation methods are adapted to inequalities; negative scaling reveals order reversal; intervals describe regions; absolute value becomes distance; formulas are rearranged without assigning numerical values.
outcomes: Interpret and graph inequality solution sets.
Explain why multiplication or division by a negative reverses order.
Translate among inequality, interval, and number-line forms.
unit.investigation: Represent manufacturing tolerance or acceptable measurement error in words, inequalities, intervals, graphs, and absolute value.
unit.mastery: Students solve, graph, and interpret mixed inequalities and rearrange formulas with units.
